name: OSH Cut
how_read: Plain HTTPS page fetch, no account, no quote; figures copied as published. Prose quotes are verbatim; 'table_row' quotes name the table, row and cells. Rules with quote_kind 'quote_page' are hand-collected from the instant-quote page (see each rule's source and source_row).
not_read: Per-thickness bend radius, k-factor, minimum flange and tooling: in the app catalogue on app.oshcut.com. Its robots.txt names anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot and Claude-Web with 'Disallow: /' (and Content-Signal ai-train=no), so the catalogue was NOT fetched; only robots.txt was read (2026-11-19).
No published minimum hole size, web, hole-to-edge or hole-to-bend figures on www.oshcut.com (its DFM checks run in the quoting app).
https://www.oshcut.com/design-guide returned 404; the design-guide index is /design-guide/learn-more.
The min/max size page prints a 'Min Size' figure (e.g. 0.1) with no unit; kept as published, not evaluated.

rules.quote: OSH Cut's standard tolerances are +/- 0.005" for most materials and thicknesses.
Our minimum material thickness is 0.02", but varies depending on the material.
OSH Cut offers metal blank cutting in material thicknesses up to 1.0" in steel and aluminum.
OSH Cut offers metal blank cutting in material thicknesses up to 1.0" in steel and aluminum.
We currently offer stainless thicknesses up to 5/8" thick
Our standard bend angle tolerances are +/- 1.0 degree.

rules.note: Gauging-surface recognition is not implemented (gap).

rules.quote: Typically, as long as the metal is 18-gauge or thicker, the integrity of the hole / depth stop should remain intact.

rules.phrasing: recommendation ('We can still cut your part')
rules.measured: least material between cut features or to the edge
rules.source_url_note: site home: the quote page is a session page whose URL was not recorded
rules.note: Derived from one part only (RP04): OSH Cut flagged one area and gave no figure. RP04's narrowest webs are 0.80 mm (hole to edge) and then 4.5 mm (not flagged), so the threshold lies in (0.80, 4.5] mm; the limit used flags only what OSH Cut flagged (0.80 mm and under). Which RP04 feature this message and the 'narrow features' one refer to was not said (the 0.8 mm web, the 1.0 mm slot or the sharp corner).
rules.quote: Small gaps - Your drawing contains 1 area that is more narrow than recommended for the selected material. We can still cut your part, but narrow regions may cause excessive heat buildup and affect the edge quality.

rules.phrasing: recommendation ('We can still cut your part')
rules.measured: width of a slot or notch (round holes are not judged: RP04's 1.2 mm hole was not flagged)
rules.source_url_note: site home: the quote page is a session page whose URL was not recorded
rules.note: Derived from one part only (RP04): one area flagged, no figure given. RP04's slots are 1.0 mm (candidate) and 7.03 mm (not flagged), so a slot threshold lies in (1.0, 7.03] mm; the limit used flags 1.0 mm and under. The message may instead refer to the sharp inside corner (not measured by mechloop) or the 0.8 mm web.
rules.quote: Narrow features - Your drawing contains 1 narrow or sharp area. We can still cut your part, but narrow and sharp features may cause excessive heating, which can reduce edge quality or burn away the material in the area.
